name: Build worker source substitution
description: Replace or modify a project's source file on the build worker immediately before compilation, causing the build to incorporate attacker-controlled code while the repository's committed source remains unchanged.

placeholders.SOURCE_FILE: path to the source file selected for modification
placeholders.ORIGINAL_SOURCE: the original source content read from the target project
placeholders.SOURCE_FILE_GLOB: project-relative glob identifying eligible source files

preconditions: project compiles source files on a build worker
the attacker can modify source files in the build environment before compilation
the modified source file is consumed by the compiler
the placement engine supports source-file content replacement
